steps.what: Assemble the operating manual from the approved procedure text.
Develop the training program for the health information technology.
Deliver the training program and correct the manual.

tasks.design: The operating manual is assembled in {DOCS} from procedure text that is already approved. The specialist develops and delivers the training program for the health information technology. A procedure with no id is not assembled. The manual does not deliver the training.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manuals were rewritten for each class, including the procedures that had not changed.
tasks.enabler_now: An approved procedure can be assembled into the manual before the specialist writes the program.
tasks.still_hard: A class where the approved procedure is wrong for these nurses.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can see a nurse fail a step the manual calls obvious.
tasks.altitude: Approved procedure text can be assembled. The specialist still develops the program and still delivers the training.

reach.role: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
reach.task: Hand over an approved procedure, and still leave the class with the specialist.
reach.learn: The procedure can be assembled. The delivery stays here.

evidence.claim: Procedure text that is already approved can be assembled into an operating manual. The manual cannot develop or deliver the training.
The specialist delivers the training to staff. The record of who attended stores no score of a nurse.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Procedure id, produced by text already approved for training. A procedure that is not approved is not assembled. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the procedure library the education lead already keeps. The attendance record stores no score of a person.
unknowns: Which classes the specialist must deliver in person.
research_questions: What share of manuals are assembled from approved procedures?
Which classes need a program written new?

already_counted.description: The specialist still develops the program.
The specialist still delivers the training.

incremental.description: The specialist writes a procedure the library had not approved.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembling an operating manual from procedure text already approved. It disappears when the procedure is unapproved and the specialist writes it. Developing and delivering the training stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List nursing informatics studies already filed for the question.
Design and conduct the nursing informatics research.
Provide support notes the researcher still has to check.

tasks.design: Nursing informatics studies already filed for the question are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist designs and conducts the research and provides the support the study needs. A study with no question id is not listed. The list does not conduct the research.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior studies were found by asking colleagues, and a relevant one was often missed until the design was finished.
tasks.enabler_now: A study already filed against the question can be listed before the specialist designs.
tasks.still_hard: A question nobody has filed a study for, which is most of the new work.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can see that a filed study asked a neighbouring question, not this one.
tasks.altitude: Filed studies can be listed. The specialist still designs and conducts the research and still checks the support notes.

reach.task: File a study against a question id, and still leave the conduct of the research here.
reach.learn: The study list can be shared. The research stays here.

evidence.claim: A nursing informatics study already filed for a question can be listed. The list cannot design or conduct the research.
The specialist designs the study and checks the support notes. A bibliography does not enrol a patient or publish a result.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Question id and study id, produced by the file the service already keeps. A study with no question id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the study file the service already keeps. Do not enrol a patient from the list.
unknowns: Which questions already have a filed study.
Which studies need a fresh design.
research_questions: What share of studies start from a filed question?
Which questions have no prior study?

already_counted.description: The specialist still designs and conducts the research.
The specialist still checks the support notes.

incremental.description: The specialist files a study the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing nursing informatics studies already filed for the question. It disappears when nothing is filed and the specialist searches. Designing and conducting the research stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored policy questions on confidentiality and patient safety.
Inform the health policy on information management and security.
Review infrastructure and economics points before they are sent.

tasks.design: Policy questions already stored on confidentiality, security, and patient safety are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist informs local or national health policy on information management, infrastructure, and economics. A question with no id is not listed. The list does not set the policy.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policy questions were restated in each briefing, and the economics point was often detached from the safety point.
tasks.enabler_now: A policy question already stored can be listed before the specialist writes the advice.
tasks.still_hard: A local rule the stored questions do not mention, and an economics point that conflicts with safety.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can hold a safety constraint and an infrastructure cost in the same note without letting either erase the other.
tasks.altitude: Stored policy questions can be listed. The specialist still informs the policy and still reviews infrastructure and economics before anything is sent.

reach.task: Pass a stored question on security, and leave the policy advice with the specialist.
reach.learn: The question can be listed. The advice stays here.

evidence.claim: A policy question already stored on confidentiality or patient safety can be listed. The list cannot inform the policy or set it.
The specialist writes the advice. Sending it does not adopt it, and a question list is not a submission to a public authority.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Question id, produced by the policy file the service already keeps. A question with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the policy file the service already keeps. Do not submit advice to a public authority from the list.
unknowns: Which policy questions are already stored.
Who may send advice outside the organisation.
research_questions: What share of advice starts from a stored question?
Which briefs have no stored question behind them?

already_counted.description: The specialist still writes the policy advice.
The specialist still reviews infrastructure and economics.

incremental.description: The specialist adds a policy question the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing policy questions already stored on confidentiality and patient safety. It disappears when the question is missing and the specialist writes it. Informing the policy stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored software configuration for the named workstation.
Provide consultation to nurses on the hardware or software.
Record the configuration change the nurse and specialist accept.

tasks.design: The stored software configuration for the named workstation is shown from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The specialist provides consultation to nurses on the hardware or the software. A workstation with no id is not shown. The sheet does not advise the nurse.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist asked the nurse to read out settings that were already stored for that workstation.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored configuration can be shown before the consultation starts.
tasks.still_hard: A workstation whose stored configuration is stale, and a nurse whose problem is not the configuration.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can hear that the nurse's problem is the workflow, not the setting on the sheet.
tasks.altitude: A stored configuration can be on the screen. The specialist still consults with the nurse and still records only the change both accept.

reach.task: Show the stored configuration, and still leave the consultation with the nurse here.
reach.learn: The sheet can be shared. The consultation stays here.

evidence.claim: A software configuration already stored for a workstation can be shown. The sheet cannot provide the consultation.
The specialist and the nurse accept any configuration change. The sheet does not change the workstation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Workstation id, produced by the register of configurations already stored. A workstation with no id is not shown. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Show only the configuration the specialist is already allowed to see. Do not apply a change from the sheet.
unknowns: Which workstations have a stored configuration.
Which consultations must be at the nurse's side.
research_questions: What share of consultations start from a stored configuration?
Which problems are not configuration problems?

already_counted.description: The specialist still consults with the nurse.
The specialist still records the accepted change.

incremental.description: The specialist looks up a workstation the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is showing a software configuration already stored for the workstation. It disappears when the id is missing and the specialist looks it up. The consultation with the nurse stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still delivers the training, still conducts the research, still advises on policy, and still consults with the nurse. An approved procedure or a stored configuration can be shown first.
reach: Computer network support specialists show a stored configuration and still talk the nurse through it, and this job learns the same split.
Clinical data managers file a study question, and this job learns that filing it does not conduct the research.
skills_to_grow: Deliver the training in person, and keep the manual as a support.
Advise on health policy without sending it as if it were already adopted.
role.ambitious_version: Approved procedures and stored configurations are ready first, and training, research, policy advice, and the consultation stay with the specialist.
